title: Screened pop

reference.source: Reference 23: pop-art halftone card collage, 736 × 736 px JPEG
reference.note: held locally; this page carries statistics measured from it and none of its pixels

summary: Gradient cards and bold shapes laid flat, separated into cyan, magenta and yellow, each printed as round dots on one 3.6 px lattice with the plates slightly off register, so every edge carries a thin fringe.
units: reference pixels; the plate is 736 × 736 and every length scales with the canvas

pitch.does: Dot spacing of every ink screen. 3.6 px measured on the green wing.

angle.does: Rotation of the lattice all three inks share. 34° measured from the autocorrelation peaks.

rosette.does: Offsets the magenta and yellow lattices from cyan by up to half a cell; 0 prints dot on dot as the reference does.

misreg.does: How far each plate lands off register (cyan left, magenta up, yellow down-right). Every color edge shows the slipped ink as a thin fringe.

cut.does: An ink under this share of the pixel's strongest ink prints nothing, so a pure red carries no cyan dots.

dotGain.does: How much each dot spreads on press: mid-tones print darker than their density.

hardness.does: Width of the ramp at each dot's edge. 0 is a hard pixel edge.

dotJitter.does: Cell-to-cell spread of dot size, as a worn plate prints: 0.3 lets each dot vary by up to 15 % of its radius.

inkNoise.does: Fine mottle in how much ink each dot takes, at a 2 px scale; it fills the texture between the lattice frequency and the flat fields.

soft.does: Blur of the whole print after screening.

grain.does: Paper noise on top; the reference sheet is flat, so the default is none.

tilt.does: Lean of the cards; the upper-left wing leans most.

wing.does: Scales every card's tilt together; negative folds the wings the other way.

gap.does: Width of the gap down the middle.

spread.does: How far the upper and lower wings sit from the middle.

lift.does: Moves the whole butterfly up or down the sheet.

drop.does: Offset of the hard shadow under every card and shape, down and to the left. No blur.

bands.does: Number of bands in the wave wing.

amp.does: Wave swing, rainbow band width and the reach of the burst.

stars.does: Stars on the rainbow's navy band.

body.does: Width of the white bead column in the gap; 0 removes it.

square.does: Side of the red square dropping below the lower-left wing.

fall.does: How far the square has dropped below the card.

seed.does: Re-rolls the star angles and the burst's teeth.

modes.saw: value up to value + amp over period seconds, then again
modes.drift: seeded walk, one step of up to amp every period seconds, folded back at the slider ends

motion.runs: only while Motion is on, at half scale; the sliders hold the center values; off by default

live.runs: only while Live is on: a drag on the figure sets x across and y down between these ends; off by default

techniques.name: Grain
techniques.implementation: Flat green: cyan dots over yellow on one lattice, so the gaps between the cyan dots read yellow.

techniques.name: Pull
techniques.implementation: A wave band's gradient: dark at one edge, toward yellow at the other, as the dots of each ink grow and shrink.

techniques.name: Edge
techniques.implementation: The gap down the middle: white beads, and the inner edges of all four wings.

techniques.name: Tone
techniques.implementation: The fan: wedge rays from the gap over a scalloped blob, each ray's gradient darkening outward.

pass_order: sheet, then four rounded cards tilted into a butterfly with a gap down the middle; the upper-left wing leans most; each card is a two-color gradient (yellow to green, red to pink, blue to sky, cyan to green)

shapes per wing, each with its own gradient and a hard shadow offset down and left: wave bands climbing toward the gap, a rainbow of tube-shaded arcs with stars, a scalloped blob under a fan of wedge rays, a jagged burst whose long tooth breaks out past its card's foot
over the wings: two stepped navy antennae, a white bead column in the gap, a red square dropping below the lower-left wing and a smaller one above it
separation: each pixel becomes cyan, magenta and yellow densities against the sheet, an ink under 45 % of the strongest is cut, 0.175 dot gain in the mid-tones
misregistration: each plate reads the art at its own offset (cyan left, magenta up, yellow down and right, 1.7 px), so every color edge shows the slipped ink as a thin fringe; the screen stays put
screen: all three inks on one square lattice at 3.6 px and 34 degrees, dot on dot as the reference prints; each dot's radius varies 5 % cell to cell; inks multiply

measured.sheet_note: the reference sheet is warm; the default sheet is neutral (247,247,244) by the brief's no-cream rule
measured.dot_lattice: autocorrelation peaks at (3,2) and (2,-3) on the green and yellow cards: square lattice, 3.6 px, 34 degrees

card_fields.method: 7 px and 9 px box means at named points; column x 100 sampled every 30 px for the lower-left gradient

measured.layout: upper wings lean out, lower wings lean back, gap about 26 px; a red square of 56 px below the lower-left wing at y 600 to 660
measured.rejected: four flat cards in a grid (the first build): the reference's cards form a butterfly and carry gradients under the screen

benchmark.computed: live, when this page loads, by the code that measured the reference: default parameters, Process palette, 1× reference size

setup.note: The composition moved to a butterfly, so the green screen, wave bands, card edge and blue gradient rects were re-picked with search.py on the plate's own wings: green at (552, 576), waves at (32, 160), a wing edge over the gap at (248, 296), the blue gradient at (56, 512). The sheet and the whole plate compare in place.

limits: Benchmark mean 0.904, lowest 0.55 (card edge navy color). Under 98 % on: every dot patch's tone histogram (0.66 to 0.84) and several ink colors. The reference is a JPEG of a print: its dots are soft, low-contrast blobs that spread each ink over a wide range of values, where the plate's dots are round with a short edge ramp, so its histogram keeps two peaks per ink pair. The card edge rect's dark class is a brown shadow (91,66,36) in the reference against the plate's darker shadow ink; the wave bands' red and green are the plate's separation of its own field colors and land 20 levels off.
The sheet is neutral (247,247,244) by the brief's no-cream rule; the reference sheet measures (255,247,234), which costs the sheet ink color 0.05.
The butterfly, its shapes and the dropping square are the plate's own; four of the dot and edge rects were placed with search.py on the plate's own wings.
notes: Deterministic: the same palette, parameters and seed give the same pixels.
A display render is capped at 2.4 megapixels; a slider in motion draws at half scale (down to a quarter on a heavy engine) and the release redraws in full.
This spec follows the controls: open it again, or leave it open, after changing them.
